text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're doing another training session devoted to Osaka Hai prep.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna try one more time.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yep.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Recently, we've been spending a good chunk of our sessions in the pool.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan has a fairly large build. To compete over longer distances, she'll benefit from working on her cardio.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We'll have less time to strategize for each individual race, but if she wants to have a shot at the senior spring season…

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Trainer <username>. What exactly is the idea here?

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Tossing balls into the pool and having her retrieve them… What kind of exercise is that?
choice_data_list: The rule is that she has three minutes to get as many as she can without taking a breath.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: I wasn't asking for details! Isn't this just some game for elementary schoolers?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It may seem like a simple game, but it steadily builds her lung capacity, and as the number of balls she can collect increases, it keeps her aware of her own progress.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: …I'm at a loss for words. You'll never win a senior-year G1 with these silly methods. Take that scrimmage the other day…

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right. We split it into two runs, but your "strategy" never changed.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: Round the fourth corner, and go all out. Then just fight to the finish.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: I asked your trainee if she was really okay with that, to which she replied she really had no strategy at all!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: She's in her senior year now. If you want her to succeed, you can't stick with these simple, childish—
choice_data_list: No. For now, simple is best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that Jordan's goal is to become the greatest dummy, the simpler the better when it comes to her training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In fact, Tosen Jordan did pretty well in that scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The true strength of her running lies in her mindset—the more aware she is of her opponents, the more fixated she becomes on winning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A simple and reckless desire to win. I want her to let that feeling really sink in—not into her mind, but into her body.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've got tough battles ahead of us. So right now, if we want to unlock her running's full potential, my job is…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Let's go one more time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …To do whatever it takes, no matter how stupid it may seem.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: S-soy sauce!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Noodles, broth, toppings! Put them together and… close with capers!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah! Just this thing Golshi was doing! I have no freaking clue what it means!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But you said to be even dumber than Golshi, so… I thought I would try to, like, copy her…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Aghhh, never mind! Just forget about it!
choice_data_list: "Close with capers"… Is that "close" as in "end closer"?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Heck if I know! I was hoping you'd tell me!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ugh, come on! Why is this happening?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Siiiiigh…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I know I'm a dummy, but do you really think I can get greatest dummy good?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ahhh…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well, here I go!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Soy sauce!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Noodles, broth, toppings! Put them together and… surge with capers!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huh? The heck you doin' over there?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Aghhh! Shut up! You think I don't know how stupid this is?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But I'm gonna surpass you! I'm gonna be the dumbest to ever do it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ohooo. Think you can outdo me, do ya?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hahahaha! You're funny! All right, then!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Bring it on. Show me what you got.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Osaka Hai begins.
